role.title: Automation & AI Integration Operator
role.mission: Design, implement, verify and hand off bounded digital systems with explicit acceptance criteria and evidence.
role.responsibility_boundary: Independent delivery within approved scope; fail-closed for identity, legal, financial, paid-spend, credential and other high-risk actions.
role.framework_note: Competency structure is informed by SFIA 9 concepts of skills, responsibility, accountability and impact. This is not a claim of SFIA certification or formal SFIA assessment.

evidence_classes.owned_system: D’AUBE-owned implementation or runtime evidence; not represented as prior client work.
evidence_classes.proof_room: D’AUBE-owned demonstration derived from a public brief; not client work.
evidence_classes.client_verified: Client outcome only when authoritative external evidence exists.
evidence_classes.issuer_verified_credential: External credential only when issuer evidence or a verification URL exists.

professional_development.model: continuous professional development with evidence-gated internal study and independent evaluation
professional_development.internal_credit_label: D’AUBE internal CPD — not university or professional-body credit
professional_development.publication_rule: Never publish an external certificate, badge, degree or professional credential until the issuer has awarded it and verification evidence is available.
professional_development.credential_data_model_note: Credential records are designed around issuer, recipient, criteria, evidence, issue/expiry and verification concepts used by modern verifiable credential systems. No Open Badges conformance claim is made.

operating_controls: Scope and acceptance criteria before execution
No fabricated client history, testimonials, certifications or revenue
No off-platform marketplace payment or deceptive sales tactics
No autonomous paid spend without explicit authority
Versioned artifacts and reproducible QA where supported

truth_boundary.self_assessed_framework_levels: not publicly presented as formal certification
